reason: Tested candidate configuration shows no demonstrated quality advantage; systematic scientific sense and claim errors remain after equal sentence segmentation. This does not establish that every possible decoding/fine-tuning of the model is inferior.
reviewType: AI-only, author-reviewed development comparison. Not blind; not human adjudication; not a population accuracy score.
comparisonBoundary: Isolated real CPU inference, sentence/clause segmentation using frozen production splitForTranslation; raw segment text without term masking. Fourteen selected existing cases are comparative development, not newly blind acceptance. Same source corpus, language directions and per-sentence processing as production; no candidate glossary/claim guard means not a full adapter equivalence test. Node CPU only, no browser/WASM performance claim. Baseline v2 targets exactly equal frozen v4 final-dist outputs as demonstrated by FINAL_DIST_SEMANTIC_BINDING.json. Candidate does not use production protected terminology or rejection guards; candidate returned text must not be counted as accepted translation. Runtime timing is observational in a shared environment, not a controlled hardware speed comparison.
